title: Funding never exceeds the target
description: For every deal id, deal.totalFunded <= deal.fundingTarget holds in every reachable state. createDeal sets totalFunded = 0 <= fundingTarget (> 0), and fundDeal reverts when amount > fundingTarget - totalFunded, so the invariant is preserved by the only writer of totalFunded.

title: Sum of investor principals equals totalFunded
description: For every deal id, the sum over all investors of investorPrincipal[dealId][investor] equals deal.totalFunded. fundDeal is the only writer and increments both the per-investor principal and totalFunded by the same amount, so the equality is maintained for all deals and all investors.

title: investorCount equals number of distinct investors
description: For every deal id, deal.investorCount equals the number of distinct addresses with investorPrincipal[dealId][addr] > 0. investorCount is incremented exactly once, on the first time an investor's principal transitions from 0 to non-zero in fundDeal, and principal never decreases in the registry.

title: Only legal status transitions occur
description: Across any single function call, a deal's status may only change along the allowed edges: Submitted->BmtApproved, BmtApproved->Mintable, Mintable->Active, Mintable->Matured, Active->Matured, Active->Defaulted, Matured->Completed, Defaulted->Completed. No other (from,to) pair is reachable, and status never moves to a lower lifecycle stage.

title: Completed is terminal
description: Once a deal reaches Completed its status can never change again: no registry function accepts Completed as a valid source status, so for every deal, status == Completed in one state implies status == Completed in every subsequent state.

title: Defaulted only moves to Completed
description: A deal in Defaulted can only transition to Completed (via completeDeal) and to no other status; in particular it can never return to Active, Matured, or any funding state.

title: Deal immutable terms are fixed at creation
description: For every deal, the fields id, invoiceHash, supplierName, anchorBuyer, bmtOriginator, apyBps, durationDays, minInvestment, fundingTarget, createdAt, and maturesAt are written once in createDeal and are never modified by any later function; only status, totalFunded, and investorCount ever change.

title: fundDeal is callable only by the vault
description: fundDeal reverts with NotVault unless msg.sender == registry.vault. No other caller can change totalFunded, investorPrincipal, investorCount, or flip a deal to Active.

title: Role gating on registry lifecycle functions
description: createDeal requires ORIGINATOR_ROLE, approveDeal requires SHARIAH_ROLE, markMintable and defaultDeal require OPS_ROLE, and setVault requires ADMIN_ROLE; a caller lacking the required role causes a revert for every such call.

title: Early maturation is privileged; late maturation is open
description: markMatured succeeds only from Mintable or Active, and before block.timestamp reaches maturesAt it requires the caller to hold OPS_ROLE or be the vault; after maturesAt any caller may mature it. completeDeal requires OPS_ROLE or the vault.

title: Vault configuration is one-shot and non-zero
description: configure requires ADMIN_ROLE, reverts AlreadyConfigured if already configured, and reverts InvalidAddress on any zero address; after the first successful call usdc, registry, and nft are set once and can never be repointed.

title: repay is gated by OPS_ROLE
description: repay reverts unless msg.sender holds OPS_ROLE. A non-OPS caller can never mature a deal or pull in the yield pool.

title: invest pulls exactly amount USDC and mints one receipt entry
description: A successful invest(dealId, amount) transfers exactly amount USDC from msg.sender into the vault, increases the vault's USDC balance by exactly amount (standard non-fee ERC-20), increases deal.totalFunded by amount, and mints exactly one receipt record / ERC-1155 unit to msg.sender for dealId.

title: invest only on Mintable deals above the minimum and within capacity
description: invest succeeds only when deal.status == Mintable, amount >= deal.minInvestment, and amount <= fundingTarget - totalFunded; otherwise it reverts (FundingClosed / AmountBelowMinimum) and moves no funds and mints no receipt.

title: repay records yield and matures without touching principal custody
description: A successful repay(dealId, totalRepayment) requires totalFunded > 0, status in {Mintable, Active}, and totalRepayment >= totalFunded; it pulls exactly totalRepayment - totalFunded USDC from the caller, snapshots yieldPool and totalFunded into the deal snapshot, and sets status to Matured. The already-held principal is never moved out by repay.

title: payoutFor is bounded by principal plus floored yield share
description: For every matured deal and investor, payoutFor == principal + floor(principal * yieldPool / totalFunded), which is <= principal + principal-share of yieldPool. Because the division rounds down, the sum over all investors of accruedYield is <= yieldPool, so the vault never owes more yield than was deposited.

title: Vault solvency over open deals
description: At every reachable state the vault's USDC balance is >= the sum over all not-yet-fully-redeemed deals of the outstanding obligations (principal for funded-but-unmatured and defaulted deals, principal + floored yield share for matured deals). redeem and claimDefault each additionally re-check balanceOf(vault) >= payout and revert InsufficientVaultBalance otherwise.

title: Each investor redeems or claims default at most once per deal
description: For every deal and investor, the combined number of successful redeem + claimDefault calls is at most one. The first successful call sets the receipt status to Redeemed and burns the token; any further redeem or claimDefault reverts AlreadyRedeemed, so double payout is impossible.

title: redeem requires a matured deal and a live receipt
description: redeem succeeds only when deal.status == Matured, the caller owns a receipt (meta.principal != 0), and the receipt is not already Redeemed; otherwise it reverts (NotMatured / NotInvestor / AlreadyRedeemed) and pays out nothing.

title: claimDefault returns exactly principal on a defaulted deal
description: claimDefault succeeds only when deal.status == Defaulted and the caller owns a non-redeemed receipt; it transfers exactly meta.principal USDC (no yield) to the caller and then burns the receipt.

title: Receipt mint requires isVerified(to) when a registry is wired
description: When identityRegistry != address(0), minting a receipt (from == address(0) path in _update) reverts NotVerified unless identityRegistry.isVerified(to) is true at mint time; when no registry is wired, minting is unrestricted.

title: Receipts are soulbound unless VerifiedOnly and both parties verified
description: Any holder-to-holder transfer (from != 0 and to != 0) reverts Soulbound when transferPolicy[dealId] != VerifiedOnly, and reverts TransferBlocked when the policy is VerifiedOnly but no registry is wired or either party is not verified. Mint (from == 0) and burn (to == 0) are always permitted, and setApprovalForAll always reverts Soulbound.

title: Mutating receipt functions are vault-only
description: mint, markDealMatured, markDealDefaulted, burnOnRedemption, and markReceiptDefaulted all revert NotVault unless msg.sender == nft.vault; admin-only setVault, setIdentityRegistry, and setTransferPolicy require ADMIN_ROLE.

title: mintedCount and burnedCount are monotonic and bounded
description: For every deal, _mintedCount and _burnedCount never decrease, _burnedCount <= _mintedCount always holds, and isFullyRedeemed(dealId) is true exactly when _mintedCount > 0 and _mintedCount == _burnedCount.

title: Deal maturity snapshot is write-once
description: markDealMatured reverts ZeroTotalFunded when totalFunded == 0 and reverts DealAlreadyMatured if the snapshot is already matured; once set, snap.matured, snap.yieldPool, and snap.totalFunded for a deal are never overwritten.

title: A burned receipt stays Redeemed and non-reusable
description: Once burnOnRedemption sets a receipt's status to Redeemed, getReceiptMeta keeps returning Redeemed (the terminal status is never re-derived from the snapshot), the ERC-1155 balance for that investor/deal is 0, and no further burn can succeed.

title: Completion requires all receipts burned when vault-driven
description: The vault calls registry.completeDeal only inside redeem / claimDefault and only when nft.isFullyRedeemed(dealId) is true, so a deal driven to Completed by the vault has every minted receipt burned (burnedCount == mintedCount > 0).
